newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas holds late short covering gains.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas holds late short covering gains.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures held slim gains late Wednesday in moderate activity, still boosted by short covering on reports of firmer physical prices ahead of cooler weekend weather, industry sources said.
At 1425 EST, March climbed 5.1 cents to $2.015 per million British thermal units, while April was still 2.6 cents higher at $2.005. Most others were up by 1.1 to 4.5 cents.

"The mild weather (this week) was in the numbers, so we're getting support today because of next week's forecast," said one East Coast trader, noting Gulf and Midwest cash firmed by about 10 cents today after slumping 25-30 cents Tuesday.
While few expected a significant rally near-term, opinions differed about where prices were headed next, with some thinking the market was overdone to the downside and due for a mild correction.
But others painted a bleak fundamental picture, with eastern stocks almost 50 percent over year-ago and only four more weeks of winter left.

A Reuter poll showed most expected a 110-125 bcf weekly stock draw when AGA releases its report later today. But eastern stocks at 261 bcf, or 50 percent, above year-ago are likely to maintain a sizeable surplus to last year.
Technical traders pegged support in March at yesterday's low of $1.85 and then at the contract low of $1.749. Resistance was seen at $2.08-2.09 and then $2.25-2.30.

In the cash, Gulf Coast prices gained about 10 cents Wednesday to the $1.90 area. Midcon pipes were up a similar amount to the mid-$1.70s. New York city gate gas was steady to up slightly at about $2.20.
NYMEX said an estimated 33,810 Hub contracts traded as of 1350 EST. NYMEX March Hub natgas expires Monday, Feb 24.
NYMEX Permian and Alberta natgas were untraded at 1420 EST.
On the KCBT, March edged up 1.4 cents to $1.72, while April was still three cents higher at $1.74. The East/West spread widened by 3.7 cents to 29.5 cents (NYMEX premium).
